Wonboard will extract surface forms, POS tags, and root information from CSV data. The derived JSON is modified data, not a new MIT dictionary. Original URLs, SHA-256 and byte counts accompany the extraction manifest. Existing public spelling assets remain unchanged until quality verification passes.
